Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We can commit to the binding volume shown below, and our demand forecast for this part is rising. We understand you are fully booked and that delivery time and a firm commitment matter to you; the long contract term we offer provides planning security, and we pay reliably on the agreed due date under the fixed payment terms. Could you confirm whether this proposal works for you?

We confirm a binding volume of 23400 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 29.89 (po:4500014436-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014337-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 29.95 per unit, 23400 units a year, 36 months, lead time 56 days.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
We acknowledge receipt of your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
Please note:
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We note your proposed volume of 23400 units and the 36-month contract term.
Accepting these parameters and a 56-day lead time allows us to adjust our price to EUR 31.70 per unit.
Your internal cost estimates do not reflect the realities of our specialised production.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Which volume can you commit to?
Please address any further questions in writing to this office.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
We can confirm that the binding volume is set out below, and the long contract term offers planning security as our demand forecast for this part is rising. We appreciate your movement in the latest offer and understand that you are fully booked and that delivery time and a firm commitment matter to you. Our proposal moves toward you again; we also confirm that payment terms are fixed for this agreement and that we pay reliably on the due date.

We confirm a binding volume of 23400 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Your on-time delivery was 79.5% in 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 31.22 per unit, 23400 units a year, 36 months, lead time 56 days.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
